rationale:
Issue #382 (labeled bug) reports that `If.block([Else([b < a])])` is silently accepted and emits malformed SystemVerilog (`if begin` with no condition), with expected behavior being a raised exception. The minimized production patch addresses exactly that: `If.block`'s constructor now validates `Else` placement (must be last, must not be first) and throws `InvalidConditionalException`, while the stale, late check that only fired during Verilog generation is removed from `generateVerilog`. The new exception file plus its one-line export are the mechanism of the throw, not an unrelated addition; the PR's separate doc-clarification commit (e60a07b) and unused-test-module removal (3bf8c86) are excluded from this revision pair, so the minimized patch equals the production portion of the single fixing commit with no formatting, refactor, config, or test-only content. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test portion of the same commit and uses only pre-existing APIs (`If.block`, `Else`, `ElseIf`, `Logic`) with the generic `throwsException` matcher, so it does not depend on the newly introduced `InvalidConditionalException` type. Strict evidence confirms all three declared selectors reproduce on the buggy revision, fixed revision is clean isolated/suite/reversed, both versions build, full suite on buggy fails only on the reproduced triggers, and determinism held over 3 repetitions (44 matrix runs, no failed checks). active_same_project_root_causes is empty and intel/rohd#382 is the sole allowed verified issue key, so this root cause is not a duplicate.

Issue #382 (labeled bug) reports that `If.block([Else([...])])` is silently accepted and emits malformed SystemVerilog (`if begin` with no condition), expecting an exception. The minimized production patch adds construction-time validation in the `If.block` constructor in lib/src/modules/conditional.dart (Else must be last, Else must not be first) and removes the stale late check that lived in the Verilog-generation path, so the single root cause is missing/mis-timed validation of `Else` position in an `If.block`. The new file invalid_conditional_exception.dart plus the one-line export in conditional_exceptions.dart exist solely to carry the thrown exception type; there is no formatting-only, docs-only, config-only, or refactor content, and the doc-comment clarification and unused-test-module cleanup from the sibling PR commits (e60a07b, 3bf8c86) are correctly excluded. The three trigger tests come from the unchanged test portion of the same fixing commit and assert with the generic `throwsException` matcher using only pre-existing APIs (`If.block`, `Else`, `ElseIf`, `Logic`), so they compile and run on the buggy revision without depending on the newly introduced `InvalidConditionalException`. Machine-generated strict gates pass in both original and post-minimization runs: build on both versions, deterministic trigger fingerprints (5 groups), buggy differential reproducing all three declared selectors, fixed isolated/suite/reversed clean, and fixed full suite all green with no baseline exclusions. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and intel/rohd#382 is the allowed verified issue key.
